source.source_id: Advances in Therapy 42(5):2490–2499, 2025 (Frangoul et al.; doi 10.1007/s12325-025-03162-2)
source.figure_table: Reanalysis of the CLIMB SCD-121 patient-level data under the broader severe-VOE definition

context.genotype: severe SCD (HbSS per trial inclusion; ages 12–35)

observation.assay: Freedom from severe VOEs for at least 12 consecutive months (broader severe-VOE endpoint: hospital/ER observation lasting ≥24 h, or ≥2 visits to a day unit or ER over a 72-h period; IV treatment required)
observation.unit: patients free from severe VOEs ≥12 consecutive months (30/30; 95% CI 88.4–100.0)
observation.evidence_locator: Frangoul, Locatelli, Eckrich, Imren, Li, Xuan, Grupp (2025); Advances in Therapy 42, 2490–2499; doi 10.1007/s12325-025-03162-2; same CLIMB SCD-121 patient-level data (reanalysis: 'These papers share a study group')

note: Same patient-level data as the pivotal trial; the endpoint reanalysis reproduces 30/30 under the alternate (broader) event rule, with the same study-group ID as P-001.
